snippet.title: Pripyat 0 - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4221600/Pripyat_0/

Pripyat 0 is an anomaly game taking place right after the Chernobyl reactor 4 meltdown. You've found yourself stuck cycling through The Zone, trying to reach safety, whilst reality crumbles around you.  

Coming to Steam, January 2026
